title: Classic · historical instruments
blurb: Where the piano came from: Cristofori's invention and the instruments Chopin, Beethoven and Liszt actually played.

items.d: c. 1720 · Florence — the inventor's own instrument, the oldest surviving piano, now in the Met.
1730s · Freiberg — the German builder whose pianos Bach finally approved.
1795 · London — the English grand with the divided bridge, the sound Beethoven pushed.
1826 · Vienna — the Viennese action and leather-covered hammers of Beethoven's last instrument.
1840 · Paris — the double-escapement action that made fast repetition possible.
1839 · Paris — the small grand Chopin preferred, with a light touch and a quick action.
1860s · Boston — the American grand with a full cast-iron plate, before Steinway.
1859 · New York — the first Steinway grand with the overstrung scale and the cast plate.
